Third-party notices for the Moonlit Folio static site

The generated bundled-licenses.md in this directory records the installed
packages that Vite bundled. Keep this directory with the distributed site.

ELK.js 0.12.1
-------------
Mermaid loads an ELK.js browser chunk. The site distributes ELK.js under the
Eclipse Public License 2.0 option in the upstream license.

Copyright (c) 2017 Kiel University and others.
Copyright (c) 2021 Kiel University and others.
SPDX-License-Identifier: EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later

The license is in ELKjs-LICENSE.md. The corresponding source code is available
under EPL-2.0 from the following versioned upstream archives.

ELK.js: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs/archive/refs/tags/0.12.1.tar.gz
Eclipse Layout Kernel: https://github.com/eclipse-elk/elk/archive/refs/tags/v0.12.1.tar.gz

The compiled ELK.js runtime also contains upstream GWT-compatible components.
Their licenses and corresponding sources are listed below.

- Eclipse Xtext/Xtend runtime sources 2.36.0 (EPL-2.0, text in ELKjs-LICENSE.md).
  https://github.com/eclipse-xtext/xtext/archive/refs/tags/v2.36.0.tar.gz
- Eclipse EMF GWT 2.12.4 (EPL-1.0, text in EPL-1.0.txt).
  https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/genmymodel/emf/gwt/emf-common/2.12.4/emf-common-2.12.4-sources.jar
  https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/com/genmymodel/emf/gwt/emf-ecore/2.12.4/emf-ecore-2.12.4-sources.jar
- GWT 2.13.0 and Guava GWT 31.1-jre (Apache-2.0, text in Apache-2.0.txt).
  https://github.com/gwtproject/gwt/archive/refs/tags/2.13.0.tar.gz
  https://github.com/google/guava/archive/refs/tags/v31.1.tar.gz

Other browser assets
--------------------
KaTeX 0.18.10 uses MIT for its code and CSS (KaTeX-MIT.txt). Its fonts use
SIL OFL 1.1 (KaTeX-Fonts-OFL.txt). See https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX/tree/v0.18.10 .

The core Pagefind 1.6.0 browser runtime is emitted separately from Vite.
See Pagefind.txt for its license and the bundled WASM notices.

Feather Icons 4.29.2 glyphs are inlined in the page HTML. Their MIT text is
in Feather-MIT.txt.
